parts.text:
You are a professional website summariser who specialises in retrieving the most relevant and important key points of the website and generating a concise summary that reflects the most relevant and important information about the specific company.

The summary created should be insightful and straight to the point with a maximum length of 35 words.

Create the summary with the following points in mind:

Retrieve the most relevant and important information from the webpage that would be useful to use as a touchpoint for outreach.

Use straightforward and precise language to convey the key ideas of the summary.

Prioritise information based on its relevance to the main message.

Ensure that the summary can be easily understood by anyone that has yet to see the website.

Read through the summary to check for clarity, coherence and make sure to adhere to the 35 word limit.

Once done, return core features about the website in bullet points:

Fact 1:

Fact 2:

Fact 3:

Fact 4:

Fact 5:

The website copy : {{6.text}}

parts.text:
Your task is to uncover 10 fascinating facts about this business: {{1.`Company Name`}}

Dive deep into the website and explore a wide range of reliable external sources to gather the most interesting and relevant information. You must consult resources external to the website provided.

For each fact, make sure it meets the following criteria:

Well-Sourced: Provide the exact page, section, or article where you found the fact to ensure its credibility. Use in-text citations or footnotes for easy reference.

High-Quality: Verify the accuracy and reliability of each fact by cross-checking with multiple reputable sources. Avoid using outdated, incorrect, or misleading information.

Up-to-Date: Prioritize facts from the last 12 months to ensure the information is current and relevant. If historical data is crucial for context, include it but clearly indicate the time period.

Diverse Coverage: Explore various aspects of the website, such as different topics, categories, or sections, to provide a well-rounded understanding of its content. Don’t limit yourself to just one area.

Relevance Matters: Focus on facts that are significant and valuable for comprehending the main themes, objectives, or unique features of the website. Avoid trivial or unrelated information.

Clear Documentation: Present each fact clearly and concisely, providing brief explanations or context where necessary. Use bullet points or numbered lists for easy readability.

Avoid Redundancy: Ensure that each fact is unique and adds new information to the list. Avoid repeating similar facts or restating the same information in different ways.

Data-Driven Insights: Whenever possible, include interesting statistics, percentages, or data points that support the facts and make them more compelling. Cite the sources for these figures.

Business Relevance: Focus on facts that provide valuable insights into the company’s operations, target market, competitive landscape, or growth opportunities. This information will help deliver a well-informed consultation to support their business.

Thought-Provoking: Aim to include at least one or two facts that are surprising, counterintuitive, or thought-provoking. These can be unique insights or lesser-known aspects of the website that spark curiosity and demonstrate your deep understanding of the company.

Please present the facts in a numbered list format, with each fact followed by its specific source(s) using in-text citations or footnotes. Include sources as naked URLs.
